convert_pytorch_to_caffe2: export a PyTorch model to ONNX and convert it to Caffe2 init_net and predict_net
add_numericalize_ops: add feature numericalization operations to Caffe2 nets using a vocabulary map for string-to-index conversion
create_vocab_index: create a Caffe2 string index from a vocabulary list and freeze it for inference
get_numericalize_net: build a Caffe2 predict net that numericalizes string inputs using vocabulary indices
create_context: reset the Caffe2 workspace and run the init_net once to set up the inference context
